clauses.statement: For every actual fixed native bounded-degree polynomial basis, constructed duals and its actual moments L(b_k) reconstruct L on the whole bounded-degree space, preserve the positive order-n Hankel domain, and give exactly the original alpha-then-mass-and-beta output without higher moments.

At the actual modified moment vector the Euclidean Jacobian is the original functional's actual sensitivity matrix in that prescribed fixed basis; every included alpha/beta sensitivity row is exactly its native basis representation coefficient, including the highest alpha row of degree at most 2n-1.

The actual fixed-basis absolute condition number is the spectral norm of the original sensitivity matrix and its normwise relative condition number includes the actual input/output norms; positive nonempty moment systems prove both vectors nonzero, so the relative normalization is defined.
